clue.text: Discussed venue for those after 7D — "Nonsensical!" said Labour

definitions.note: an island in the South Atlantic floated in 2020 as a place to hold people seeking refuge (7 Down)

indicators.note: to labour is to work, and worked material is reshaped, so these letters are worked into a new order

explanation.surface: A politician dismisses an idea as nonsense, with the Labour Party speaking out against it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'said Labour' reads as the Labour Party speaking, but 'said' is part of the fodder and 'Labour' (work) is the anagram signal. In 2020 the UK government reportedly considered sending asylum seekers to this remote British territory.
explanation.definitionFit: The remote British territory was reported in 2020 as a proposed processing site for asylum seekers, people seeking refuge.

clue.text: Moon to make an attempt at seduction? That's not unknown!

explanation.walkthrough: 'Try it on' is a British idiom for making advances (or chancing one's luck).
explanation.definitionFit: Neptune's largest satellite is named after a sea god, so it is a moon.

clue.text: Half of the clergy in NW town

parts.note: ecclesiastic is an adjective meaning relating to the church or clergy

explanation.walkthrough: The town is near Manchester in North West England, famous for its currant-filled Eccles cakes.
explanation.definitionFit: The town lies in Greater Manchester, in the North West region of England.

clue.text: Polite young man, Kylie stressed

clue.text: Rector streaked outside? Was curious to know more

parts.note: pied means blotched or streaked with two colours

clue.text: Illustration features, mainly, type of skin disease

indicators.note: features in the sense of includes or contains, so the picture word holds the next piece

parts.note: pic is short for picture, an illustration

indicators.note: mainly means most of it, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a sort is a type or kind

explanation.surface: A medical picture shows, for the most part, a kind of skin disorder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'type of skin disease' looks like the definition, but 'type' gives SORT for the wordplay, leaving 'of skin disease' as an adjectival definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Psoric is an adjective meaning relating to scabies or psoriasis, itchy conditions of the skin.

clue.text: Pile on to player

parts.note: re means on or about, as in a letter heading

explanation.surface: Piling it on for an actor, heaping praise on a performer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pile' is the old name for a nuclear reactor, from the stacked graphite blocks of the first ones.
explanation.definitionFit: An atomic pile was the original name for a nuclear fission unit, as built by Fermi in 1942.

clue.text: Retreat official — fancy resistance's given way

clue.text: What flipping blockhead put in order for Murdoch publication?

the head of the word block is its first letter, B

explanation.surface: An exasperated question about a stupid person's order regarding a newspaper owned by Rupert Murdoch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Murdoch publication' suggests Rupert Murdoch's newspapers, but it is a 1958 novel by Iris Murdoch.
explanation.definitionFit: Iris Murdoch published the novel set at a lay religious community in 1958.

clue.text: Group must accept it's wrong — send rude message …

parts.note: a set is a group

explanation.definitionFit: To sext is to send sexually explicit messages by phone.

clue.text: … after we slyly condemned those challenging government (not right)

indicators.note: condemned suggests damned or wrecked, so the preceding words are broken up and reset

explanation.surface: The ellipsis continues a rude message, after which a group is slyly condemned.

explanation.definitionFit: Activist left-wing barristers who challenge ministers in court, a pejorative phrase coined by the Home Office in 2020.

clue.text: Fresher's explanation ultimately ignored but it does hold water

indicators.note: ignored says this letter is dropped from the word

parts.note: newer means fresher

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the following word

explanation.surface: A first-year student's explanation is ignored but still holds water as an argument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hold water' reads as an argument being sound, but means a jug holds water.
explanation.definitionFit: A large wide-mouthed jug used for carrying water, so it literally holds water.

clue.text: Breaks code of silence over government's wrongdoings

indicators.note: over in the sense of covering, so one word goes round the letter

parts.note: sins are wrongdoings

explanation.surface: A whistleblower breaks the code of silence about government misdeeds.
explanation.definitionFit: To sing is slang for to inform to the police, breaking the criminal code of silence.

clue.text: Secure though not all together

indicators.note: not all of the next word is used, only a stretch inside it

explanation.surface: A security measure, though not all of it fits together.
explanation.definitionFit: To secure something is to obtain or acquire it.

clue.text: Top amongst German aircraft

parts.note: a lid is the top of a container

explanation.surface: A top-ranking figure among German aircraft.
explanation.definitionFit: A glider is an aircraft that flies without an engine, using air currents.

clue.text: I bar canoe rolling as exercise

explanation.walkthrough: 'canoe rolling' looks like a sport but 'rolling' is the anagram signal.

clue.text: Dissolved substances — use lots at work

indicators.note: at work suggests being busily worked over, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A chemist uses lots of dissolved chemicals in the lab.
explanation.definitionFit: In chemistry, the substances dissolved in a solvent form a solution.

clue.text: Weaken nun — wise move

indicators.note: move tells the solver to shift the letters around into a new order

explanation.surface: Undermining a nun would be a smart move.
explanation.definitionFit: To deprive of sinew, the tendons that give strength, is to sap or enfeeble.

clue.text: Old master with stock found in Charlie's place? He'll have questions to answer

parts.note: ex means former or old

a mine is a rich source or stock of something

clue.text: Sank independent filmmaker

parts.note: to fall in is to cave in or sink

explanation.surface: An independent filmmaker sank without trace.
explanation.definitionFit: Federico Fellini was the Italian film director of La Dolce Vita and 8½.

clue.text: Long jumper doesn't want strong field

parts.note: a flea can jump many times its body length
F is forte, loud or strong in music

clue.text: See 1
Dispatch note to Cons

parts.note: to have someone is to con or trick them

explanation.definitionFit: Dispatch means speed or promptness, as in acting with dispatch.

clue.text: Drama over — avoid having to leave North Island

indicators.note: having to leave says this letter goes

parts.note: to shun is to avoid

parts.note: Sp is the abbreviation for Spanish
raw can mean naked or unclothed

clue.text: Will it stop houses going up though?

houses says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

What's not close for travelling? American islands
